suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-5 adds this relationship only as a bounded clinical proposition. Require documented pulmonary fibrosis and a separately established diagnosis of pulmonary hypertension under accepted clinical/hemodynamic criteria. Do not infer pulmonary hypertension from dyspnea, hypoxemia, reduced DLCO, or a nonspecific echocardiographic estimate alone. Preserve other pulmonary-hypertension causes and groups, including left-heart disease, chronic thromboembolic disease, sleep-disordered breathing, drugs/toxins, and other lung diseases. The cited literature supports only this constrained relationship and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent documentation of pulmonary-fibrosis and pulmonary-hypertension
Chronology and phenotype compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of competing etiologies, shared risk factors, and treatment effects where applicable
